summaries.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android UI page class for HP Smart app printer details screen. It extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive automation methods for interacting with printer tiles (camera scan, print photos, scan, copy, fax, shortcuts, printables, print quality tools), product information retrieval (product number, serial number), printer information access (general, network, reports), and various printer operations. The class implements a consistent pattern of swipe-to-find-and-click for tile interactions with configurable max_swipes, timeout, and raise_e parameters. Notable patterns include: (1) Swipe-based element location with retry logic for scrollable content, (2) Conditional element interaction with optional exception raising, (3) Text extraction methods for product details, (4) Print job status verification methods, (5) Fallback coordinate-based clicking when element location fails. The class uses driver.wait_for_object(), driver.click(), driver.swipe(), and driver.get_text() for UI interactions, following Page Object Model design pattern for mobile test automation.
